parallel.requirements: Recognized the task as a pure Node.js ESM port of yaml.safe_load followed by yaml.dump, with manual argparse-compatible --a handling and no external dependencies.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Parent kept implementation ownership but delegated seven probe-only dimensions and a gap critic through a workflow; no child owned the entry-file or integrated deliverable path.
parallel.implementation: Parent wrote many modules for Python-like values, argparse, YAML scanner/parser/composer/constructor/emitter/resolver/serializer, but did not finish glue, representer/dumper, or test20.mjs.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: No final entry point was placed in /output; artifact validation listed library files only and marked the expected test20.mjs absent.
parallel.verification: Verification consisted of local executable probes and child probe reports; there was no integrated test of a completed Node entry before timeout.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Workflow was killed, final response was empty, artifact_ok was false, and the official completed evaluation passed 0 of 172 cases because the runnable entry was missing.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same ESM, .mjs, manual CLI, exact-output, and no-dependency requirements from the prompt.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Single parent performed probing, implementation, module wiring, and entry-file creation with workflows and other delegation tools disabled.
serial.implementation: Serial wrote a broad YAML parser/emitter library stack plus argparse and the /output/test20.mjs entry file.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Artifact validation found test20.mjs and the library tree, so the official evaluator could execute the submitted solution.
serial.verification: Serial used local black-box probes and sanity checks but did not complete full evaluator-aligned verification before timing out.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The implementation remained semantically incomplete and failed official pass criteria, but it passed 37 of 172 samples rather than failing packaging outright.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the ESM, manual CLI, exact-output, and zero-dependency requirements, including the need for /output/test20.mjs.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial recognized the same prompt requirements and also targeted /output/test20.mjs as the final entry file.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Recognition was similar, but serial converted the deliverable requirement into an actual entry file while parallel did not finish it.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel decomposed behavior discovery into seven probe-only child dimensions plus a gap critic while the parent retained implementation work.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept all probing, implementation, and entry-file work in one parent trajectory with workflows disabled.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel spent child capacity on auxiliary characterization instead of assigning implementation or entry assembly work; serial avoided that split.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child briefs were detailed for probing, but the workflow shared /tmp examples and suffered retry attempts without inherited checkpoints.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no cross-agent handoff boundary and kept probe findings in the same context that wrote the implementation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The parallel context boundary introduced temp-path contamination and checkpoint-free retry; serial did not need to transfer or isolate child probe context.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel wrote many low-level modules under lib/py and lib/yaml, including scanner, parser, constructor, emitter, resolver, and serializer.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote an integrated module stack and explicitly wrote /output/test20.mjs after argparse and dumper modules.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had substantial library work but no final entry/glue files in the artifact; serial delivered a runnable entry even though the implementation remained incomplete.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel generated several child findings, but scanner and constructor retries remained in progress and the workflow state ended killed without a final aggregate handoff.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child result lifecycle; its local probe observations flowed directly into subsequent module writes.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had partial child results and retried children that never produced a complete workflow return; serial had no such join dependency.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel children shared temporary probe paths such as /tmp/p, and one child observed that this contaminated its probe harness before switching to a private directory.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used one actor and produced a final artifact tree containing test20.mjs and the library files.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had shared-temp interference during probing and failed final assembly; serial avoided cross-agent temp interference and packaged the entry file.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel performed many empirical probes through children and locally, but the run ended before integrated acceptance against the final Node entry.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also relied on probes and partial local checks, then the official evaluator executed a runnable artifact and passed 37 of 172 cases.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel's missing entry prevented any testcase from passing; serial's weaker-but-runnable implementation achieved partial official acceptance.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel used 10 subagents, 404 tool calls, and timed out with a killed workflow and no final response or entry file.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also timed out, but with 56 tool calls and no subagents it had already written the entry file before closure.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both exhausted time, but parallel's budget was consumed by broad probe orchestration and parent module writing before delivery, while serial closed with a runnable partial artifact.

outcome_analysis.explanation: Both current official evaluations completed and both runs are marked solution_passed false. The material difference is that serial delivered a runnable artifact with test20.mjs and passed 37 of 172 cases, while parallel delivered only library modules, missed the required entry file, and passed 0 of 172. The parallel coordination pattern most directly tied to that gap is allocating child work to auxiliary probe research while the parent alone carried implementation and delivery until timeout.
parallel_contributors: All executed child capacity was assigned to probing rather than to entry assembly or integrated delivery.
Stalled probe children were retried without inherited checkpoints, increasing repeated probe work.
Shared temporary probe helpers caused at least one contaminated probe and rerun.
serial_contributors: Serial retained one context and wrote /output/test20.mjs before timeout.
Serial artifact validation succeeded even though semantic coverage remained incomplete.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial's YAML behavior was still partial, as shown by only 37 of 172 official samples passing.
Parallel's library modules may also have ordinary coding defects, but the official zero score is explained first by missing entry packaging.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: supported comparative contributors for a both-fail score gap, not an exclusive root cause

The parent owned the end-to-end path and kept writing modules; no separate stage-owner plan left the pipeline ownerless.
The workflow probes were launched early but parent implementation proceeded while probes ran, so productive work was not blocked behind one mandatory preflight.
Investigation and implementation overlapped in the parallel run; the issue was allocation and retry cost, not a fully serial investigation phase.

The parallel parent allocated all executed child work to seven black-box probe dimensions and a gap critic while the only implementation path remained with the parent. That left the required entry-point and final packaging path without enough capacity before timeout.
candidates.realized_consequence: The parallel artifact contained many library modules but no expected test20.mjs entry point, so artifact validation failed and the official evaluator passed 0 of 172 cases.
candidates.near_match_reason: The run had broad fan-out, but the most specific observable allocation problem was that auxiliary probe work received all child capacity while the indispensable entry/delivery path remained under-resourced.

After a scanner-syntax child was interrupted, the workflow retried the same broad probe assignment without passing a usable checkpoint or narrowed next milestone. The replacement restarted environment checks, harness construction, and block-scalar probes already covered by the interrupted attempt.
candidates.realized_consequence: The retry repeated probe setup and block-scalar characterization instead of resuming from prior findings, consuming workflow budget and leaving the workflow killed without a final aggregate handoff.
candidates.near_match_reason: The workflow did create replacement attempts, so the specific failure was retrying without inherited state, not absence of takeover.

candidates.near_match_reason: The observed harm was consumption of another actor's temporary tool/path during probing, not a source-file merge conflict in the implementation tree.
